sources.title: MHINDR - a DSM5 based mental health diagnosis and recommendation ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Mental health forums offer valuable insights into psychological issues, stressors, and potential so-lutions. We propose MHINDR, a large language model (LLM) based framework integrated with DSM-5 criteria to analyze user-generated text, di-agnose mental health conditions, and generate per-sonalized interventions and insights for mental health practitioners.
